regions.text: 同様の事態を左の図形によつて表現することもできる。

quote.translation: The same state of affairs can also be expressed in the following figure 〔Figure 11〕.

regions.text: 偶然性は、不可能性を表はす直線内に於てをの二點であると同時に、可能性を表はす三角形に於てその頂點である。

quote.translation: Contingency is a point within the straight line representing impossibility and, at the same time, the apex of the triangle representing possibility.

regions.text: 偶然性は虚無である偶然維と共に實在である。

quote.translation: Contingency is nihility, and it is reality as well.

regions.text: 虚無即實在である頂點は生産點として三角形全體の存在を擦ふ力である。

quote.translation: The apex, as nihility that is at once reality, is the force that bears, as producing point, the existence of the whole triangle.

regions.text: 三角形の底邊は發展生産の終極として完成の狀態にある必然性を表はす。

quote.translation: The base of the triangle represents necessity, in its state of completion as the end of developmental production.

regions.text: 偶然性はみづから極徴の不可能性でありながら極徴の可能性を実端の危きに捉へることによっで、「喪」を「改」に異へ「改を「衰」に受け、可能性に可能性を孕んで、.に必然性に合致するのである。

quote.translation: Contingency, itself an infinitesimal impossibility, seizes infinitesimal possibility at the perilous extreme point, gives "I" to "Thou" and receives "Thou" into "I", conceives possibility within possibility, and finally coincides with necessity.

regions.text: 必然性と不可能性とを同じ長さの機線ABとABとを以て表はしたのは雨者に共通の確瞪性を象徴するためである。

quote.translation: Necessity and impossibility are represented by horizontal lines of the same length, AB and A′B′, in order to symbolise the apodicticity common to both.

regions.text: それに反して偶然姓と可能性とが一點より發してその極限に於て初めてABの二點に合するのは偶然性と可能性とに共通の問題性を象徴するためである。

quote.translation: Contingency and possibility, by contrast, issue from a single point and coincide with the two points of AB only at their limit, in order to symbolise the problematicity common to contingency and possibility.

The single point of contingency and the line of necessity are drawn thick and black to represent the actuality common to both, and possibility and impossibility are drawn with dotted lines to express the non-actuality common to both.
